name: North Sydney: Arthur St and Alfred St beside the Warringah Fwy and the Cahill Expressway

move.why: Arthur St beside the Warringah Fwy's motorway link south of Mount St: OSM draws it 2.4 m east of where it is in NSW's aerial, and its carriageway 0.75-2.4 m into the link's, 4-6 m lower in its cutting, so the ground under its outer lane was the link's (check-layers: ground 4.1 m under it at (-230, -3812)). Moved west to its kerbs in the aerial, leaving 0.9-1.5 m for the wall between
Arthur St from Mount St to its bridge over the Warringah Fwy, beside the motorway link: moved west with the junction (above), back onto OSM's line where it turns onto the bridge

Alfred St North from Mount St's end to its turn at Bent St, beside Alfred St at the foot of its retaining wall: its carriageway and Alfred St's overlap 0.3-0.8 m along it, up to 2 m where Alfred St bends at Darley St and Bent St comes in, 5-6 m apart in height (overlaps: 5.1 m at (-119, -4089), 6.4 m at (-118, -4221)). In NSW's aerial the two run a wall apart, OSM's line 0.5 m east of this one's middle: moved west 1 m

Alfred St North south of Mount St's end, beside Alfred St: moved west with the stretch north of it (above), up to 1.5 m where OSM bends it 7.7 m from Alfred St's line (overlaps: 1.9 m at (-119, -3979))

Alfred St from Darley St south, beside Alfred St North at the top of its retaining wall: moved east 1 m, as far as it runs beside it, back onto OSM's line by Mount St; with Alfred St North moved west 1 m their carriageways are a wall apart. NSW's aerial has its middle 0.5-0.9 m east of OSM's line
Alfred St from Bent St to Darley St, below Alfred St North: moved east 1 m with the stretch south of it (above), its junctions with Bent St and Darley St with it

Alfred St North where it curves west to its bridge over the Warringah Fwy, beside the Cahill Expressway's lane down into its tunnel under the junction: its carriageway 1.8 m into the lane's, 5 m higher (check-layers: the ground 4.97 m under its lane at (-131, -3774)). Moved west up to 1.9 m, into the planted median on its other side, as far as the lane runs beside it
Bent St's last 30 m down to Alfred St, beside Alfred St North 6 m higher: moved east up to 1 m with the junction (Alfred St, above), into the bank on its outer side
